title: LSNR: Learned Sparse News Recommendations with Attentive User Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.23510v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current learned sparse approaches for recommender systems, such as STAR, represent a user by concatenating their interaction history into a single query string. For news, this creates two bottlenecks: concatenation collapses a user's distinct reading interests into one flat query, and, because news articles are long-form text, concatenating several news articles quickly overruns the context window of the language model used as backbone and forces quality-degrading truncation.   To address both bottlenecks, we introduce learned sparse news recommendations (LSNR). LSNR encodes each article independently and constructs a sparse user vector by combining learned, attention-based weighting of the per-article sparse representations with a dense-projected expansion at the user level. Experiments on the MIND and EBNeRD datasets show that LSNR significantly outperforms STAR, with these gains holding even in short-history settings where truncation

translated_title: LSNR：基于注意力用户建模的学习稀疏新闻推荐
translated_abstract: 当前推荐系统中的学习稀疏方法（如STAR）通过将用户的交互历史拼接成单个查询字符串来表示用户。在新闻场景下，这会带来两个瓶颈：拼接操作将用户各自不同的阅读兴趣压缩成一条扁平的查询；同时，由于新闻文章属于长文本，拼接多篇新闻很快就会超出作为骨干的语言模型的上下文窗口，从而被迫进行损害质量的截断。为了解决这两个瓶颈，我们提出了学习稀疏新闻推荐（LSNR）。LSNR对每篇文章进行独立编码，并通过将基于学习的注意力加权作用于每篇文章的稀疏表示，再结合用户级别的稠密投影扩展，来构建稀疏用户向量。在MIND和EBNeRD数据集上的实验表明，LSNR显著优于STAR，并且即使是在历史记录较短、需要截断的设置下，这些优势依然保持。
tldr: LSNR通过独立编码每篇新闻文章，并结合基于注意力的加权与用户级稠密扩展来构建稀疏用户向量，解决了现有学习稀疏推荐方法在新闻场景下用户兴趣被扁平化以及长文本导致截断的两大瓶颈，在MIND和EBNeRD数据集上显著优于STAR。
en_tdlr: LSNR overcomes the flat-interest and truncation bottlenecks of learned sparse news recommenders by independently encoding each article and combining learned attention-based weighting with user-level dense expansion, significantly outperforming STAR on MIND and EBNeRD.
